package.description: MiniReel 是一款短剧播放器，支持真人剧、漫剧、AI 剧与动漫分类浏览，可在手机、电视与桌面端连续观看。

en-US.description: MiniReel is a short-drama player for browsing and watching live-action, animated and AI-generated series on mobile, TV and desktop.
en-US.longDescription: MiniReel is a short-drama player. Pick a series you like, watch it with intuitive controls, bookmark favourites and pick up where you left off. The desktop app offers a slim icon sidebar and keyboard shortcuts, with a mini always-on-top window for watching while you work. No account is required; favourites, watch history and settings stay on your device.

zh-CN.description: MiniReel 是一款短剧播放器，支持真人剧、漫剧、AI 剧与动漫分类浏览，可在手机、电视与桌面端连续观看。
zh-CN.longDescription: MiniReel 是一款短剧播放器。挑一部感兴趣的短剧，用顺手的操作观看；喜欢就收藏，下次打开接着看。桌面端提供窄图标侧栏与键盘快捷键，迷你置顶窗口陪你办公追剧；无需注册账号，收藏、观看记录与设置只保存在本地设备。
zh-CN.name: MiniReel
